_what: What each training source contains, and therefore what it obliges. Read by core/data_sensitivity.py. An undeclared source is refused, not assumed safe.
_why_declared_not_inferred: The harness run record already carried the sentence 'the data is the system's own security decisions, not the principal's records'. That is true today, it is a claim in a comment, and nothing rechecks it when the source changes. The financial programme is about to point the same machinery at an asset registry holding institutions, balances and benefit records.

security_eval.why: ACL and signature decisions about which AGENT may touch which RESOURCE. No human's records are in it; a model that memorised all of it would have learned config/resource_acl.json, which is already public in this repository.

distillation.why: Input-output pairs from /reason. core/distillation.py redacts any prompt naming a live matter or a personal record before it is written.

asset_registry.why: Institutions, account types, last-fours, balances, counterparties and obligations. Memorisation leaks the principal's finances, and weights cannot be corrected the way a record can.

account_layers_private.why: The VA entitlement, the fiduciary appointment, DEERS, military pay. These describe a protected status rather than a preference.

cases.why: Live matters including the HUD-VASH housing case - participants, obligations and evidence references about identifiable people.
